comment: Enter in a filter dialog's number field takes the number and applies nothing. Gaussian Blur opens in the Filter dialog, 23 is typed into its Radius field, and one Enter goes in as a keyboard sends it. The state after says the dialog is still up, the slider at 23 out of its text box and the preview run again, and the history as it was. Then the same in the filter edit window, on a blur attached to the layer, whose preview is the record's own write. Every Enter leaves its window open, so each is cancelled by hand. Nothing is saved.
01, the Filter dialog on Gaussian Blur at its default radius of 10.
02, 23 typed into the Radius field, before Enter.
03, one Enter: the dialog stays up with the slider at 23 and the preview run on it.
04, a blur attached to Paint, opened in the filter edit window.
05, 23 typed and one Enter: the window stays up and the record holds 23, with no step.
